Team / Anna / GCP PM —

Quick note to kick off a short sync on Nova Analytics. They asked about a marketplace-first approach to simplify procurement and speed deployment across their clinic partners. GCP indicated co-sell could get us introduced to their purchasing lanes if we have a marketplace listing + mutual action plan.

Asks:
- Vanessa / Laura: can you pull the current Nova opportunity notes and confirm which SKUs (hosted API vs dedicated) they are considering?
- Karthik: can you surface any marketplace blocker items (privacy attestation, billing & listing deadlines)?
- Mateo: can you prepare a short cost comparison (hosted vs dedicated with estimated monthly tokens/traffic) for Anna?

Anna — appreciate the intro. If you can share the procurement timeline and the legal contact we can align the DocuSign cadence. I attached a quick marketplace checklist and a draft MOA for us to iterate on.

Proposed next step: 30-minute joint review Wednesday 3/17 at 11:00 PT if that works for everyone. If GCP PM wants to join that slot, we can use it to confirm co-sell next steps.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Wednesday 3/17 11:00 PT works for me. For procurement: procurement@nova-analytics.com is the right inbox; our legal lead is Mara Patel (copied in the procurement thread). High level timeline: we aim to have commercial terms agreed by the end of April and procurement signoff by mid-May.

Couple of requests on our side so the marketplace listing is useful for our procurement team:
- Clear billing flow that maps to our PO process (marketplace billing preferred)
- Evidence of SOC2 or equivalent — we can accept self-attested docs initially but need an audit report before production scale
- A concise one-page summary of supported deployment options and data flow (we need this for compliance review)
